swimming_pool.evidence: The blue pool in the top-left corner sits on a neighboring lot, not the central one. No pool is visible on the central lot.

signals.notes: The central house has a multi-gabled gray asphalt roof with some staining and sits on a dry, patchy lawn. Two vehicles are parked in the driveway on the east side. A neighbor to the northwest has a pool, but it is not on this lot.
